text: {"lessons":["My account grew from 96,822 to 109,776 overall, despite several down months; one month’s return does not define the outcome.","Because price changes are unpredictable, I should not chase recent gains or react impulsively to declines.","Since I have not traded and my account still rose overall, I should trade only when a clear plan justifies it, while respecting my cash and share limits."]}
